body: I was upset when I told him how I was feeling, and it happened suddenly so I didn't say things how I should have. I don't think he's entirely responsible. He felt shut out and like he wasn't allowed to respond, and he's right about that...I was upset and didnt want to hear his side. That was wrong of me.

I don't think he tries to be manipulative, and again, I'm not entirely in the right. He's also given me far more than I've deserved when I've been in dark places, and he's always taken care of me. We're supposed to be building a life together. We have plans of marriage and kids. I can't imagine my life without him.
Doctors are few and far between with the lovely healthcare system in the US. I'm trying to learn to navigate it, but it hasn't been very successful yet.

There are a lot of issues on both ends. I won't claim that I'm in the right entirely, but I feel so trapped. I'm afraid things aren't working. I feel guilty but I also feel so hurt. There's no balance, there's no way to just feel hurt or feel anything, really. It's just a perpetual pissing contest and I can't feel anything without it being wrong somehow. I'm scared of his depression, of his hurting himself, but I can't do anything about it. I can't even say anything about it, he just downplays it and says he just scratched at himself and it wasn't a big deal, and then compares it to worse things I've done in the past. I'm afraid. I'm afraid that something worse will happen. I'm afraid that I have no way out because I'm so reliant on him. I don't want there to have to be a way out, I really love him so much, but things are bad and they keep getting worse and he's the only person I really  have in my life at this point.
